06 — THE FRESH APPROACH

From opportunity to intelligence in action.

A practical, human-led approach to building AI that works in the real world.

F
F — FindPhase 01 · Week 1

Find the workflow that’s costing you most

We sit with the people doing the work and map every step, handoff and system it touches, with the minutes each one takes. Then we rank and price what is worth handing to AI.

You receive

The AI Opportunity Map, ranked and priced in dollars and hours.

R
R — ReadyPhase 02 · Weeks 1 to 4

Ready the data and systems it depends on

We connect to the systems the job runs on, with access you grant and can revoke. Then we clean and structure the data the job needs, build the test set from your own signed-off cases, and lock the scope and price before the build starts.

You receive

A working connection to every system the job touches, a fixed-scope build plan and a fixed price.

E
E — EmbedPhase 03 · Weeks 4 to 8

Embed agents inside the work, not beside it

We build the agents and workflows inside the systems the job already runs on, in your cloud account, so the work happens where your team works today. Nothing leaves your environment.

You receive

A working product inside your systems, under your access rules. You own the code.

S
S — SafeguardPhase 04 · Weeks 4 to 8

Safeguard it with security, guardrails and human approval

We set up security before it touches live work: access rules you control, audit logs, and a walkthrough with your security team. Then we run it in shadow mode beside your team. It does the work, your people check it, and nothing posts on its own until it clears the accuracy bar you set.

You receive

A product live on your systems, secured, with a person approving what matters.

H
H — HonePhase 05 · Ongoing

Hone it in daily use, every week

We set the rules for who can see and change what, watch it daily, tune it until the number holds, and report the results every month. It is the step most projects skip, and the one that keeps results steady long after launch.

You receive

Access rules, monitoring, runbooks you own, and a monthly results report.
